scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.build: node build_gates.js && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd client && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../server && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:all: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init AALGOLAKSHMI com.aalgo.v2 --web-dir client/dist
